metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature, observed with MODIS Aqua, in Arizona higher on July 15-21, 2017 than the 2001-2010 average for the same period?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Collection: MODIS/061/MYD11A1 (Aqua daily LST Day 1km).
- Location: Arizona boundary from TIGER/2018/States.
- Dates: Target: 2017-07-15 to 2017-07-22; Baseline: 2001-01-01 to 2010-12-31 filtered to day-of-year 196–202 (July 15–21).
2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask using QC_Day: require LST produced (bits 0–1 < 2) and acceptable data quality (bits 2–3 <= 1). Convert to Celsius and mask out-of-range values (-100 to 80 C).
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check collection size; if 0 for either period, C1.
- Count valid pixels on the mean image; if 0 for either, C2.
- If mean is null/NaN or out of plausible range, C3.
- Otherwise compare 2017 mean vs baseline mean: A if higher, B if not.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  function getInfo(eeObj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      eeObj.getInfo((res, err) => {
        if (err) reject(err);
        else resolve(res);
      });
    });
  }

  const region = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States')
    .filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Arizona'))
    .geometry();

  const start2017 = '2017-07-15';
  const end2017 = '2017-07-22';
  const datasetId = 'MODIS/061/MYD11A1';

  function maskLST(img) {
    const qc = img.select('QC_Day');
    const produced = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).lt(2); // bits 0-1: LST produced
    const qualOK = qc.rightShift(2).bitwiseAnd(3).lte(1); // bits 2-3: good or other quality
    const lstC = img.select('LST_Day_1km').updateMask(produced.and(qualOK))
      .multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15).rename('LST');
    const plausible = lstC.gt(-100).and(lstC.lt(80));
    return lstC.updateMask(plausible).copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
  }

  function getCol(start, end) {
    return ee.ImageCollection(datasetId)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(region);
  }

  async function summarizePeriod(col) {
    const size = await getInfo(col.size());
    if (!size || size === 0) {
      return {empty: true, size: 0};
    }
    const maskedCol = col.map(maskLST).select('LST');
    const meanImg = maskedCol.mean();

    const totalPix = await getInfo(
      ee.Image(1).rename('LST').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e13,
        bestEffort: true
      }).get('LST')
    );

    const validPix = await getInfo(
      meanImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e13,
        bestEffort: true
      }).get('LST')
    );

    if (!validPix || validPix === 0) {
      return {empty: false, size: size, valid: 0, total: totalPix || 0, mean: null};
    }

    const meanVal = await getInfo(
      meanImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e13,
        bestEffort: true
      }).get('LST')
    );

    return {
      empty: false,
      size: size,
      valid: validPix,
      total: totalPix || 0,
      mean: meanVal
    };
  }

  try {
    // Collections
    const col2017 = getCol(start2017, end2017);
    const baseCol = getCol('2001-01-01', '2010-12-31').filter(ee.Filter.dayOfYear(196, 202));

    // Check empty collections
    const size2017 = await getInfo(col2017.size());
    const sizeBase = await getInfo(baseCol.size());

    if (!size2017 || size2017 === 0 || !sizeBase || sizeBase === 0) {
      console.log(`2017 Images: ${size2017 || 0}`);
      console.log(`2001-2010 Images: ${sizeBase || 0}`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Summaries
    const sum2017 = await summarizePeriod(col2017);
    const sumBase = await summarizePeriod(baseCol);

    // Pixel counts and validity checks
    if (sum2017.valid === 0 || sumBase.valid === 0) {
      console.log(`2017 Images: ${sum2017.size}`);
      console.log(`2001-2010 Images: ${sumBase.size}`);
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Validate results
    const v2017 = sum2017.mean;
    const vBase = sumBase.mean;

    const invalid2017 = (v2017 === null || Number.isNaN(v2017) || v2017 < -100 || v2017 > 80);
    const invalidBase = (vBase === null || Number.isNaN(vBase) || vBase < -100 || vBase > 80);

    if (invalid2017 || invalidBase) {
      console.log(`2017 Mean LST_C: ${v2017}`);
      console.log(`Baseline Mean LST_C: ${vBase}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Print concise evidence
    const totalPix = sum2017.total; // same region/scale; reuse for percentage reference
    const p2017 = totalPix ? (sum2017.valid / totalPix * 100.0) : 0;
    const pBase = totalPix ? (sumBase.valid / totalPix * 100.0) : 0;

    console.log(`AZ pixels (1km): total=${totalPix}`);
    console.log(`2017-07-15..21 Images: ${sum2017.size}`);
    console.log(`2017 Valid px: ${sum2017.valid} (${p2017.toFixed(1)}%), Mean LST_C: ${v2017.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`2001-2010 (Jul 15-21) Images: ${sumBase.size}`);
    console.log(`Baseline Valid px: ${sumBase.valid} (${pBase.toFixed(1)}%), Mean LST_C: ${vBase.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Delta (2017 - baseline) C: ${(v2017 - vBase).toFixed(2)}`);

    // Final answer
    if (v2017 > vBase) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
